description: This file defines a Flutter widget called QuizCard that displays information about a quiz, including its title and description, and provides a button to start the quiz. It manages gesture interactions and animations for user feedback.

classes.name: QuizCard
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays quiz details and a start button.

classes.description: Manages the internal state of QuizCard, including gesture interactions and scaling animation.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the QuizCard, including gesture detection, scaling, and layout of quiz info and start button.
